name: twilight_thorn_host_fight_creeper_tether
description: VUH-2617 lead #344: twilight_thorn_host_fight_creeper_potion plus partnerTether (thorn_tether.py): during Thorn's volley, outside revive windows with both seats up and no Creeper engagement, the seat farther from Thorn steers toward its partner while they are more than 1300 apart. VUH-2617 lead #343: twilight_thorn_host_fight_creeper_protect plus rescuePotionReserve (thorn_potion.py): the fight's last Potion is kept for a rescue; ordinary, opening and post-revive-grace heals treat it as unavailable while the partner is up, and the pre-revive heal still uses it. VUH-2617 lead #328: twilight_thorn_host_fight_creeper_orbhold plus rescueProtect (thorn_protect.py): while the partner is logically downed and this seat's revive is in progress or it stands within 300 of the partner, an offered 432/667 Reversal is not taken (no RC press, no fresh Triangle) so the revive hold and approach continue. VUH-2617 lead #302: twilight_thorn_host_fight_creeper plus rescueOrbHold (thorn_orbhold.py): while Thorn is in its orb volley (motion 202) and the downed partner lies 1250+ from Thorn, the rescuer waits within 1000 of Thorn instead of walking to the partner, then approaches when the volley ends (capped at 30 s per revive window). VUH-2617 lead #282: twilight_thorn_host_fight plus Creeper-first targeting on the host seat (thorn_creeper.py, creeper_policy.py). Kills a Creeper (317) within the engage radius before returning to Thorn; revive, logical downs, RC/Reversal, events, the existing low-HP heal/evasion and Thorn's dazed opening keep priority. Everything else is unchanged.

steps.note: Native pad combat begins immediately. Only297/298/299 may use Triangle during the owned camera event, with exact initial room scope and living/logical-down checks. The known first-hit menu0/event0 box still receives bounded Cross; unknown event RCs receive no Triangle.
